scope: F_base/F_expansion only; fit_expanded_member true for training slices

definition.time: replay_export_time; offline network export clock, not actual receipt or label time
definition.bins: complete calendar UTC hour/day intervals; including empty intervals; no outcome-based window selection
definition.Q: normal rows in immediately previous interval or all strictly earlier intervals, separately described
definition.E: all fit rows whose feature export time lies in the interval; normal denominator separately retained
definition.component_filter: AIT normal action candidate graph components, using unknown candidates as graph bridges and all candidates for time bounds; exclusion counts apply only where action links are known. Unraveled rows have no per-action partition and are not certified independent by this filter.
definition.composition: disjoint tuple of existing normal-unit memberships; observed total variation, not proof of population drift
definition.dependency: all slices remain inside their original complete run/campaign training role, not independent evaluation episodes
definition.rank_resolution: ceil(.99*(n+1)) <= n requires n>=99; floor(n/100)>=1 requires n>=100; alpha=.01 delta=.05 NP max-order feasibility requires n>=299
